criteria.fresh_running_jump_40: Hold right+B, release A for1frame then hold A40frames. Start a full sustained running jump when Mario feet visibly stand on ground/platform and a nearby visible obstacle or gap requires height/distance. Issuing this in midair cannot start a fresh jump on landing.
criteria.fresh_walking_jump_40: Hold right, release B; release A1frame then hold A40frames. Start a full walking jump from a visible solid surface to clear a tall obstacle with less horizontal travel. Cannot start a new jump while airborne.
criteria.run_forward_4: Hold right+B, release A, 4frames. Advance on clear ground, descend toward landing, or release A so a fresh jump can follow.
criteria.run_forward_8: Hold right+B, release A, 8frames. Advance along safe ground or descend to land before initiating another jump.
criteria.run_left_8: Hold left+B, release A8frames. Back away from a wall/hazard or create room for a future jump.
criteria.sustain_running_jump_8: Hold right+B+A8frames. Sustain a rising jump for height; do not release A early if a tall obstacle must be cleared. Does not reset A for a fresh jump.
criteria.walk_forward_4: Hold right, release A+B, 4frames. Advance slowly, descend toward landing, or prepare a fresh jump with precise positioning.
